question:
If 2 is subtracted from each of the numerator and the denominator of a fraction (a)/(b), it becomes (1)/(4).

If 17 is added to the numerator and 8 is added to the denominator of the original fraction , then the fraction becomes (7)/(7). What is the value of (4a - b)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify that the expression 4a − b is directly related to the first condition.

Ratio (a − 2) : (b − 2) = 1 : 4 implies 4 × (a − 2) = 1 × (b − 2).

Expanding the terms gives 4a − 8 = b − 2.

Rearranging the equation to isolate the required value: 4a − b = 8 − 2.

Solving the constant difference: 4a − b = 6.

**∴ Answer = 6**
